description: This file contains a PHP class definition for compiling the {assign} tag in the Smarty templating engine, including methods for processing attributes and generating PHP code for assignment within templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Assign
classes.description: A class responsible for compiling the {assign} tag within Smarty templates, enabling variable assignment with scope control and cache options.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to implement the {assign} tag, handling attributes, scope, caching, and output of the compiled code.
